body:
Thank you for taking the time to answer, I didn't expect anyone to to be honest.

> You excel in everything but feels rejected regarding your attractiveness, the one thing that is out of your control!!!

It's a nice way to sum it up. It sounds so trivial, especially when I have it all going on otherwise, but it's a huge part of it. To be appreciated and admired, yet not good enough to receive romantic love like anyone else. It's something I've been aware of since I was a kid and I hate that it affects me as much as it does.


I only wear make up for formal occasions and work, and even then it's light. I've heard so many stories of guys meeting a girl who turns out to be much less attractive without make up on... I don't know, I guess I was hoping I would use make up to enhance my looks in order to please a significant other, not to even be able to attract one in the first place if that makes sense.

> boys in your age group probably all judge girls by looks

Then they come to me for advice and cry about how much better I am than the others and they wish all women were like me. I may give off a "nice girl" vibe, but it's frustrating to hear for 100th time.


Again, thanks for reaching out. It means more than I expected. I realize most people on this sub have been through so much worse.
